column1: # Compiler-generated DATA with no reachable source spelling, in two classes:
#   common  a COFF COMMON cl emits from a header-inline's function-local static
#           (DATA() is main-file-only) or its ??_B dynamic-init guard byte (no
#           source spelling at all). No owning TU exists - cl emits a copy into
#           every instantiating TU and the linker merges them - so only the
#           retail address is stated; owner documents the emitting header inline.
#           Everything else is re-proven against the base objs' COMMON tables
#   copy    a reviewed per-TU copy of a header static (the GruntDirStatics
#           device, docs/data-attribution.md): owner is the emitting TU, decided
#           by its $E static initializer's position. Several rows may share one
#           rva (each TU's copy folds onto the same retail byte).
# labels.py folds both classes into build/gen/symbol_names.csv.
